const projects = [
  {
    name: "HALO-FL-Scheduler",
    text: `Project: HALO-FL-Scheduler
Domain: federated learning, distributed systems, fault tolerance, adaptive scheduling

Problem: Federated learning requires coordinating multiple devices that can have different capacities and may disconnect during training. HALO-FL-Scheduler addresses adaptive participant scheduling and fault tolerance in a Flower-based federated learning environment.

Stack: Python, Flower, Federated Learning, Tailscale, telemetry, adaptive scheduling.

What I built: I implemented an adaptive federated learning scheduler using capacity scoring to select and assign participating devices. I also implemented a telemetry agent for collecting device information, fault-tolerant dropout recovery using stable device identities, and a live monitoring dashboard. I tested the scheduler across multiple laptops and deployed it across machines connected through a Tailscale network.

Result: Successfully verified adaptive scheduling and dropout recovery across multiple machines; no formal benchmark yet.

Relevant for roles in: federated learning, machine learning engineering, distributed systems, Python backend, AI infrastructure, edge AI.`
  },

  {
    name: "Chetna / Safe Sphere",
    text: `Project: Chetna / Safe Sphere
Domain: edge AI, healthcare technology, computer vision, sensor fusion, mobile AI

Problem: Elderly and vulnerable users may require rapid assistance during falls or environmental hazards, including situations where internet connectivity is unavailable. The system focuses on offline-first detection and emergency assistance.

Stack: TensorFlow Lite, 1D-CNN, Gemini API, Firebase, sensor fusion, NLP, mobile application development.

What I built: I designed an offline-first edge AI system for fall detection using a TensorFlow Lite 1D-CNN model. I integrated environmental signals including light, noise, air quality and temperature for proactive risk analysis, and designed a multimodal emergency protocol involving SOS activation and caregiver monitoring. The system also includes a Firebase-based caregiver dashboard and a voice-activated emergency trigger.

Result: The fall detection model achieved 94% classification accuracy with sub-50ms local inference latency in the project evaluation.

Relevant for roles in: edge AI, machine learning, TensorFlow, TensorFlow Lite, computer vision, mobile AI, healthcare AI, sensor fusion.`
  },

  {
    name: "Emotion-based Music Playlist System",
    text: `Project: Emotion-based Music Playlist System
Domain: computer vision, facial emotion recognition, recommendation systems

Problem: Traditional music selection does not account for the user's current emotional state. This project uses facial expression analysis to identify emotions and use them to drive music selection.

Stack: Python, Flask, DeepFace, OpenCV, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

What I built: I developed a system that uses DeepFace-based facial emotion recognition to analyze a user's detected emotional state. I integrated the emotion detection functionality with a Flask backend and web interface to create an emotion-driven music experience.

Result: Functional prototype developed; no formal benchmark yet.

Relevant for roles in: computer vision, deep learning, Python, Flask, OpenCV, facial analysis, AI applications.`
  },

  {
    name: "Disease Diagnosis Chatbot",
    text: `Project: Disease Diagnosis Chatbot
Domain: NLP, semantic search, machine learning, healthcare AI

Problem: Users may need an accessible way to describe symptoms and retrieve information related to possible diseases from a structured medical dataset.

Stack: Python, SentenceTransformer, FAISS, NLP, machine learning.

What I built: I developed a medical chatbot using a Kaggle disease and symptom dataset. I used SentenceTransformer to generate semantic representations and FAISS for similarity-based retrieval. The system processes symptom-related queries and retrieves relevant information from the indexed dataset rather than relying only on exact keyword matching.

Result: Functional semantic retrieval prototype developed; no formal diagnostic accuracy benchmark yet.

Relevant for roles in: NLP, retrieval systems, semantic search, machine learning, Python, healthcare AI, vector databases.`
  },

  {
    name: "Drone-based Fire Detection and Extinguishing System",
    text: `Project: Drone-based Fire Detection and Extinguishing System
Domain: computer vision, autonomous drones, robotics, path planning

Problem: Firefighting in hazardous environments can expose people to significant risk. The project explores the use of drones to detect fire and support firefighting operations remotely.

Stack: Python, computer vision, LiDAR, D* algorithm, drone systems.

What I built: I designed a two-drone concept consisting of a detector drone and a fighter drone. The detector drone is intended to identify fire locations while the fighter drone performs the corresponding firefighting task. I worked with LiDAR-based environmental sensing and D* path planning concepts to support autonomous navigation between relevant locations.

Result: Prototype/project system developed; no benchmark yet.

Relevant for roles in: computer vision, robotics, autonomous systems, drones, path planning, AI, edge computing.`
  },

  {
    name: "Fire Fighting Rover",
    text: `Project: Fire Fighting Rover
Domain: robotics, embedded systems, computer vision, autonomous systems

Problem: Firefighting environments can be dangerous for humans, so a remotely controlled or autonomous rover can be used to approach fire locations and assist with firefighting.

Stack: Python, robotics, sensors, computer vision.

What I built: I developed a fire-fighting rover concept designed to detect and approach fire while providing a safer mechanism for firefighting operations. The project involved integrating sensing and robotic movement concepts for operation in hazardous environments.

Result: Prototype/project implementation; no formal benchmark yet.

Relevant for roles in: robotics, computer vision, embedded AI, autonomous systems, IoT, machine learning.`
  },

  {
    name: "MNIST Digit Classification",
    text: `Project: MNIST Digit Classification
Domain: deep learning, image classification, neural networks

Problem: Handwritten digit recognition is a standard computer vision problem used to demonstrate development and evaluation of a neural network classifier.

Stack: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, deep learning.

What I built: I developed and trained a neural network model using the MNIST handwritten digit dataset. The project involved preparing image data, defining the Keras model, training the network and evaluating its classification performance.

Result: Functional MNIST classification model; no benchmark included here.

Relevant for roles in: deep learning, computer vision, TensorFlow, Keras, Python, machine learning engineering.`
  }
];

return projects.map(p => ({ json: p }));
